commander_specific_reason: The 6/6 trampler, combat-damage draw and graveyard-cast permission after three tapped Pirates/Vehicles add resilience. Mandatory draw and the loss of Bident's optional draw/force-attacks mode are recorded trade-offs.
At X=3 it costs five mana, makes three selected Pirates unblockable and draws for each that hits. Target three Pirates to directly satisfy the commander's same-player trigger.

Raid can reduce it to one blue mana after attacking, letting the deck protect the critical combat step. It costs three mana on opponents' turns versus Counterspell's two; Mana Drain and free protection remain.

Persistent flying is useful, but convoke taps the creatures that pay for it and those creatures normally cannot attack that turn. Cover of Darkness already supplies repeatable fear; Open into Wonder is more direct for a same-turn trigger.
Lookout's Dispersal is a one-blue tax-four counter with a Pirate, but not a hard counter. Admiral's Order is a hard counter for one blue after attacks, specifically protecting the commander trigger.
It offers a Pirate anthem and discard on combat damage, but is a Vehicle requiring crew and overlaps Captain Vargus Wrath, Corsair Captain, Dire Fleet Neckbreaker and Shared Animosity.
Four-mana Pirate Treasure production is synergistic, but Black Market Connections, Captain Lannery Storm, Malcolm, Edward Kenway and Storm the Vault already support the mana plan.
Treasure-driven counters are incremental and do not solve the three-Pirate evasion requirement as directly as Open into Wonder.
Useful low-cost Pirate utility, but current interaction and theft/value density are adequate; Open into Wonder has greater direct impact on the commander condition.
Flying Pirate hand disruption is efficient, but the deck already has several evasion bodies and interaction; the slot is spent on a same-turn three-Pirate finisher.
Optional draw and forced attacks are useful, but the replacement adds a 6/6 trampler and graveyard-cast resilience; Open into Wonder gives direct evasion.
Single-creature unblockability costs three mana each turn; Open into Wonder can make three Pirates unblockable and draw multiple cards in a decisive turn.
Loses a two-mana off-turn hard counter, but Admiral's Order can cost one blue after attacking when the combat threshold is at risk; Mana Drain and free protection remain.
Choosing Pirate can double Admiral's end-step trigger and other Pirate triggered abilities; a core tribal multiplier.
Pirate tutor and drain on Pirate entries; Roaming Throne can amplify its trigger.
Choosing Pirate can return non-Pirate permanents, creating a tribal-sided reset.
Primary combat finisher that scales a wide Pirate attack.
Tribal draw engine; strong but mandatory triggers can accelerate library depletion when stacked with other combat-draw effects.
Rewards stolen permanents with buffs and Treasure; core theft payoff.
